caption: I put R900 on betting and told no one. Do you ever add yours up?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R11 800
p/m wages
Living in Mokopane
slides.body:
Male, 33
Married, one son (2)
Job: Broiler house worker, chicken farm
Net wages: R11 800 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Two room backyard unit, shared tap
slides.body: The landlord is my uncle's friend. That is the only reason it is R2 600.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Pap, chicken feet, nappies, the odd braai pack
slides.body: My wife does the list. I do the extras at the till.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.body: It goes the day I am paid. I have never once seen it as extra.

slides.title: Taxi fare
slides.includes: Two taxis each way to the farm, six days a week
slides.body: The second taxi is the one that gets me. It is R15 more every time they raise it.

slides.title: Sports betting
slides.includes: Weekend soccer slips, R50 or R100 at a time
slides.body: I would have said R300. It is R900. I have not told my wife the real number.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: prepaid electricity, funeral policy, stokvel, airtime & data, crèche
slides.body: Five small things I never add up. Together they are R2 320, and the funeral policy is the one I would never cancel.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R11 800. That is about R4 a day until payday. One taxi fare increase and it is gone.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and the betting slips were sorted into one category.

Seeing R900 on its own line was hard.

No bank login needed.
